$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: Unique table id; the game reads "element-feedback".

notes.description: Where the looks come from and what is placeholder.

handleCap.description: Most element effects live at once; beyond it the farthest from the camera go.

fullDetailCap.description: Most element effects drawn at full detail. Beyond it the farthest drop to low LOD (`lowLodIntensity`) and only beyond `handleCap` are they culled.

lowLodIntensity.description: Emission multiplier of a low-LOD effect (fewer particles, same look and size).

hysteresis.description: Metres of preference an effect that is already live gets over a rival at the cap, so two things at the same distance do not trade places every frame.

property.description: World property that drives the state (burning, wetness, frozen, charge…).

atLeast.description: A number property is at least this (and the state is on).

when.description: When the property counts as on.

precedence.description: Look precedence, higher wins. An entity in several states has their looks layered lowest first: the highest precedence tints last (on top), and takes the roughness when several states set one. Glows add. Order used: wet 10 < burning 20 < charged 30 < frozen 40, so a wet and frozen thing reads iced.

effect.description: VFX effect played on the entity while the state is on.

referenceRadius.description: Bounding radius, metres, the effect is authored for; larger things scale it up.

scale.description: Limits on bounds-driven effect scale (1 = as authored).

reducedIntensity.description: Emission multiplier while reduced motion is on (strobing sparks use less).

look.description: Material look of the entity’s mesh in this state.

tint.description: Colour the albedo is mixed towards (white leaves it alone, a dark colour darkens).

tintMix.description: How far the albedo moves towards `tint`, 0 = not at all … 1 = fully.

emissive.description: Glow colour added to the surface (emissive).

roughness.description: Roughness the surface takes (low = a specular sheen, as wet or iced things have).

pulseHz.description: Glow pulses this many times a second, at most 3 (photosensitivity, style bible §7); 0 = steady. Reduced motion holds it steady.

audioCue.description: One-shot sound cue played where the entity is when it enters the state; only cues in the sound manifest play. Absent while no cue exists.

states.description: The states, in the order looks combine.

transitions.description: One-shot effects when an entity moves between states (burning to wet: steam).

to.description: State id the entity enters (in either order within one tick).

effect.description: One-shot effect spawned once at the entity per transition.

referenceRadius.description: Bounding radius, metres, the effect is authored for.

scale.description: Limits on bounds-driven effect scale (1 = as authored).

reducedIntensity.description: Emission multiplier while reduced motion is on.

fields.description: Gases of the element field drawn as clouds (smoke, steam).

gas.description: Gas id in the element field, e.g. "smoke" or "steam".

effect.description: Looping cloud effect held on each dense cell.

threshold.description: Concentration (0–1 of a cell) at which a cell gets a cloud.

cap.description: Most clouds of this gas at once; the densest win.

referenceCell.description: Cell edge, metres, the effect is authored for; the cloud scales by cell size over it.
